method: Faithful component harness extracting the real commitHistoryMarkup/syncHistoryChildren/getHistoryScrollOwner/restoreHistoryScroll into a real scroll container; drove 850ms auto-poll (markup changed each tick) while simulating user scroll via wheel events.
root_cause: commitHistoryMarkup re-restored the captured scrollTop on the NEXT animation frame (window.requestAnimationFrame -> restoreHistoryScroll(before.scroll_top)). When a poll's refresh coincided with the user scrolling, that rAF fired AFTER the user moved and yanked scrollTop back to the pre-scroll position. With polling every 850ms and markup changing each tick (card fields), the scroll repeatedly reverted -> 'tela volta/salta' and 'difícil/impossível continuar descendo'.

evidence.non_scrolling_user: position preserved across changed/grow/same polls (1143 throughout, incl. after rAF)

was_full_rerender: NO (an incremental keyed DOM patcher already existed; the bug was purely the scroll re-restore fighting the user)
scrollIntoView_or_focus: NO (renderRuntime does not touch history scroll/focus; no scrollIntoView in the refresh path)
